items.q: is Ray Brown. Out at the studios. He gets a very good sound and he to me is very reminiscent of Blanton and his work.

ctx.x: Can you describe Blanton's sound as compared to what we hear on records?

Well, it's -- it's richer than the fender-bass, much richer. A very mellow sound. I'll tell you there's one bass player around that gets a similar sound, I can't -- I wouldn't say, whether it's a -- how much better it is or lesser it is, anything like that -- is Ray Brown. Out at the studios. He gets a very good sound and he to me is very reminiscent of Blanton and his work.
Did you hear the album that he and Duke made for Norman Granz (inaudible), called, 'This One's For Blanton.'?
